The main facility is on 42nd Avenue and Clement Street at the former Fort Miley Military Reservation in the Richmond District.  Fort Miley is located south of the Golden Gate and west of the San Francisco Presidio, on Point Lobos (San Francisco) surrounded by the Golden Gate National Recreation Area.
